How i run a self-improving Hermes agent organization built on four pillars.

• Direction: I set goals, approve, and correct when needed. 
• Execution: Hermes chief-of-staff, specialists agents own domains, and CLIs act.
• Learning: Skills preserve what works. Memory stores taste.
• Feedback: Outcomes and metrics improve the next run.

Goal is not just to complete more tasks. It is to build an agent org that gets smarter every day.
